'''Velx-Shel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
This planet was [[Velx-Shel raid|raided]] by a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] include [[Arkle Tellaro]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="H&S">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref> Its name came from the [[Velx family|Velx]] and [[Shel family|Shel families]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
